content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, many creators are left without viable options for monetizing their work. Traditional systems are often tied to geographical and regulatory constraints that limit access in certain countries, including Kenya. COREMERCH's infrastructure bypasses these limitations by utilizing blockchain-based payments and decentralized hosting solutions. With platforms built on technologies like Cloudflare and Google Apps Script, your ecommerce setup is not just a workaround—it's a robust, fully functional system. You gain complete control over your operations, ensuring that you can sell your ebooks without interruption. This infrastructure sovereignty means you can focus on what you do best: creating and selling, while your payment processing runs seamlessly in the background.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting the deployment process, gather the necessary tools and resources for setting up your ecommerce infrastructure. You will need a domain name and hosting solution, which can be covered using free options like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Prepare your product files, ensuring your ebooks are ready for delivery. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, which will enable you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. You should also have a reliable cloud storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storing and delivering your ebooks. Lastly, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit to access all blueprints and templates required for building your ecommerce site efficiently, ensuring you hit the ground running.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your chosen hosting solution. Start by configuring your payment settings in NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. Create a webhook that will handle payment confirmations automatically. Next, link your cloud storage solution to your ecommerce site, which will allow for seamless delivery of your ebooks to customers upon successful purchase. Ensure that your digital products are properly uploaded and accessible via the links you will provide in your store. Test the entire process with a small transaction to confirm that payments are processed correctly, and the delivery is executed smoothly. This step is critical to ensure that when customers make purchases, they receive their products instantly without any hitches.
Bypassing payment platforms opens new revenue streams.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live. Make sure your website is fully operational, with all links tested, and your product pages are functional. Promote your ebook through social media channels, personal networks, or communities that align with your target market. When a customer makes a purchase, monitor the transaction through the NOWPayments dashboard to ensure it is processed as expected. Upon confirmation of payment, the delivery webhook should automatically trigger, sending the ebook to the customer’s email or directly linking them to the download page. Track your sales and customer feedback to refine your selling strategies and improve the shopping experience over time.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, consider scaling your operations to maximize revenue. Start by expanding your product line; if you are selling ebooks, think about offering courses or templates that complement your existing offerings. Use the scaling playbook provided in the Complete Builder Kit to identify opportunities for growth. Additionally, optimize your marketing strategies by utilizing social media advertising or partnerships with influencers in your niche. Gather data on customer preferences and buying behavior to refine your approach. Automation tools can help you manage multiple products and transactions more effectively, allowing you to focus on creating new content while your infrastructure supports your expanding business.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Acquire a domain name and select a hosting solution (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages). 2. Prepare your ebooks and upload them to a cloud storage service (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). 3. Set up a NOWPayments account to process cryptocurrency transactions. 4. Integrate NOWPayments with your ecommerce site, creating a webhook for payment confirmations. 5. Test your entire transaction process with a small payment to ensure everything functions correctly. 6. Promote your ebooks through social media and other channels. 7. Monitor transactions and customer feedback for continuous improvement.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use any cryptocurrency for payments?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose the ones that work best for your business and your customers.
What if I need support during deployment?
Purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes support resources and documentation to guide you through the deployment process.
How do I ensure my ebooks are secure?
Store your ebooks in a reliable cloud service and use secure links for delivery. This maintains control over your files and ensures only paying customers can access them.
Are there any fees for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, which is competitive compared to traditional payment platforms.
Can I scale my business easily after deployment?
Yes, the infrastructure is designed for scalability, allowing you to add more products and expand your offerings without significant barriers.
Infrastructure sovereignty ensures you're never locked out of your income.
